text:
mari: heads up — main CI just turned red right after #789 merged. gpu-smoke step failing with allocator errors. anyone oncall?

jordan: saw it, pinging @ops-oncall. link to pipeline: https://ci.redwood.local/6950001234. quick logs show `KV cache alloc failed` repeatedly.

ops-oncall: grabbing now, I see repeated OOM-ish traces on gpu-03. starting a rerun to confirm if flake.

deploy-bot: pipeline 6950001234 triggered by merge of PR #789 (mari). Status: red. Failing step: gpu-smoke. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.local/6950001234/artifacts

ops-oncall: rerun kicked off -> job 6950001248.

mari: thanks. PR touched kvcache eviction thresholds and a small tensor init change. could be related.

sasha: quick grep of logs from the failed run shows: `runtime error: expected freed block but found used` around kvalloc. throwing `AllocatorError: insufficient contiguous memory`.

kevin: fwiw, I reproduced locally on a dev machine with the same model shard using small batchsize. suspect change in eviction ordering.

jordan: if rerun comes back red, can we bisect to the PR range? who can run a bisect?

ops-oncall: rerun returned red (job 6950001248). same trace. grabbing a minimal bisect now.

mari: @kevin can you start a bisect across the commits in the PR? start with the tensor-init tweak vs the eviction change.

kevin: starting bisect. command I'm using: `./scripts/ci-bisect --range origin/main~5..origin/main --test gpu-smoke --retries 2`

sasha: adding some short logs to help: ```
E 03:21:45 AllocatorError: insufficient contiguous memory for kvalloc (requested 1.2GB)
E 03:21:45   at kvcache/alloc.cc:142
E 03:21:45   at runtime/serve.cc:88
```

ops-oncall: throwing a temp rollback of the merge as an option? we could revert the PR and unblock deploys if bisect takes long.

mari: prefer to bisect quickly first — rollback will be last resort. if bisect pins it to the eviction commit, we can hotfix.

kevin: bisect update: first half green, second half red — narrows to the eviction reorder commit.

jordan: nice, can you open a hotfix PR reverting that one change and mark it urgent? I can help review.

kevin: opened PR #793 that reverts the eviction reorder. linking: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/793

ops-oncall: i'll queue a CI run for #793 and promote if green.

deploy-bot: CI for PR #793 started. Status: running.

mari: great work everyone — please post results. if #793 passes, we'll roll it to main and then re-run the downstream release smoke. :thumbsup:

jordan: also leaving notes in the PR about follow-up: add an allocator unit test and increase trace logging around kvalloc to prevent blind regressions.

sasha: agree. after hotfix we should also add a guarded fallback in runtime to avoid hard OOMs.

ops-oncall: PR #793 passed CI. promoting to main now. job 6950001310 for promoted roll.

deploy-bot: promotion job 6950001310 succeeded, main is now green.

mari: closing the loop — main back to green. filing a brief incident note summarizing root cause and next steps. thanks all. :rocket:
